latestVersion.changelog:
Audio-to-Text Skill 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Convert audio files (MP3, MP4, WAV, M4A up to 500MB) into captioned video with automatic speech-to-text transcription.
- Simple conversational interface; upload an audio file and describe your desired output (e.g., "transcribe this audio and add captions").
- Handles backend authentication, session creation, audio upload, transcription, and video export transparently.
- Supports checking credits, showing current timeline state, and tracking export progress.
- Designed for podcasters, content creators, and educators needing quick, accurate captioned videos.
